label: Cruiser Escort
note: IP-neutral. Issue #193: the company on the way up to the Remnant cruiser (Oda's last job). The cruiser's interceptors scramble as you clear the atmosphere; two of the port's pilots fly up with you. The Remnant flies only its interceptors and frigates (remnant_freighter, the cruiser's own). Z within reach of the cruiser docks you in its bay: the fight goes on without you while you are aboard and picks you up again when you fly out; it ends when the general dies (RemnantCruiser), when every wave is down, or when you are.
